title: Animal population measurements with self-owned JFR capture
acceptance_criteria: Can each isolated JVM export its own recording with valid ownership, population, phase and render-call evidence, without external attach?
What server tick, client frame, GC and primary-thread sampled-stack evidence accompanies 100 parrots, 100 kobolds and 40 mixed animals?

checks.rationale: Real isolated join and 100-parrot measurement. Each JVM dumps its own named recording, followed by offline analysis. R31 completed the population phase but failed external JFR export; it supplies no accepted performance metrics. Existing process ownership and native limits remain unchanged.
